description: This file defines a Java interface 'MaintenanceLogRepository' that extends Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository, providing data access methods for MaintenanceLog entities and including a custom finder method 'findByVehicle'.

classes.name: MaintenanceLogRepository
classes.description: An interface extending JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and custom queries for MaintenanceLog entities.

methods.name: findByVehicle
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MaintenanceLog entries associated with the specified Vehicle.
